dataset_name: CCPH — observed real-world Project Intersection changes / Project Intersection 실제 연구 변경 관측
objective_en: Collect real, verifiable changes produced during ordinary project research, rather than benchmark scores. Attach later confirmed intellectual and societal consequences without rewriting earlier uncertainty.
objective_ko: 별도 벤치마크 점수가 아니라 일상적인 실제 연구 수행의 변경·기여·비용과 후속 영향을 증거별로 누적하며, 미래 증거가 생기면 과거 판단을 버전으로 수정한다.

coverage.caveat: Event and file counts are activity measurements, not impact-size, improvement percent, scientific validation, causal attribution or compensation assessment.

source_boundary: All evidence pointers are public GitHub repository URLs; third-party source bodies, conversation transcripts, private personal and financial data are not copied.

participants.role: Public research collaboration and target repository; not a legal person or sole inventor

outcomes.description: Merged 3 changed repository files introducing an AI-mediated impact lineage schema, the bilingual continuity policy extension and TOC link. / AI 매개 영향계보 스키마·영한 연구정본·목차 링크가 포함된 변경 파일 3개가 병합됨. File count measures changes, not usefulness, welfare or improvement.
Actual contributor effort, compensation, lost opportunities, consent beyond public metadata, social benefit and harm not quantified.

uncertainty.selection_mechanism: Nonrepresentative, deliberately selected adjacent merged PRs #167–169 in Project Intersection public repository; excludes private/offline work and other PRs.
limitations: A verified repository change is not an independently established causal improvement.
Prior art and named contributors to each component require distinct source-level audits.
No claim that this selection is complete or unbiased.

privacy_and_control.retention_or_withdrawal_rule: Link public provenance and allow versioned corrections. Handle requests affecting third-party privacy or law case by case; never re-publish private raw dialogue.

scope_limitations: Only selected public GitHub changes, not full research history or offline influences.
